subject: Rollup banners + 10ft backdrop proofs — expedited shipping quote
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna@brightprint.co>
To: hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sales@brightprint.co
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mockup proofs and expedited shipping quote — rollup banners & backdrop

Hi Hiro / Laura,

Attached are the updated proofs for the rollup banners and the 10ft fabric backdrop: rollup_proof_v3.pdf (2.1MB) and backdrop_mockup_v1.png (1.3MB). We made the bleed adjustments you requested and bumped the logo contrast in the backdrop file so the red reads correctly under LED stage lights.

Production notes / options:
- Rollup banners (33" x 80") — qty 8. Material: matte vinyl (recommended for low reflection).
- 10ft fabric backdrop — dye-sublimated polyester on stretch frame.
- Typical lead time (standard): 48 hours after sign-off + daytime ground transit (2–3 days).
- Expedited option (overnight to venue): additional $180 per shipment; guaranteed delivery by 10:30 AM if shipped same day before 2:00 PM PT.
- Small proof charge waived for this job.

Quoted expedited costs (if you confirm today):
- Production rush + overnight courier to Moscone West, SF: $180 (overnight) + $325 (rush production) = $505 total (one-time). Shipping will include tracking and proof of delivery.

We can hold production until we receive:
1) final sign-off on color/bleed (pdf approval), and
2) shipping instructions and contact at receiving dock.

Invoice/quote attached as BP_Quote_4472.pdf. If you want us to ship directly to the hotel for speaker kits instead of the venue, note that there will be an additional handling fee.

Let me know which finish you prefer (matte vs gloss for banners) and whether to proceed with overnight courier.

Thanks,
Anna Li
Account Manager | BrightPrint Co
(415) 555-0192
attachments: rollup_proof_v3.pdf, backdrop_mockup_v1.png, BP_Quote_4472.pdf

Thanks Anna — the proofs look close. Quick notes inline:
- Rollup banners: please go with matte vinyl. We had glare issues at previous venues with gloss.
- Can you confirm the safe area is 12mm from edge? The copy on the bottom feels tight on two of the banners.
- Backdrop: the reds are improved; for the stage we actually need slightly warmer reds (Pantone 186C-ish). Can you send a color-adjusted JPG proof for the backdrop?

Event logistics: the booth load-in at Moscone West is Tues 04/20, exhibitor receiving opens 07:00 AM. We need the banners and backdrop onsite for install team by 08:30 AM. If overnight is required, we need shipping to arrive by 07:30 AM.

Please confirm whether the overnight option in the quote will meet that delivery window and if BrightPrint will schedule delivery to the exhibitor receiving dock (contact: Miguel Ramos, miguel.ramos@moscone.org, +1 415-555-2030).

Attaching a quick comments doc with markups: hiro_proof_comments.docx

If we can get a firm overnight price and committed ETA, I can approve immediately (we're on a tight lead time).

— Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
